verdict.rationale: SumUp's first-party SDK docs describe Offline Transactions that let merchants keep accepting card payments when connectivity is unavailable or unreliable. They also describe a store-and-forward flow in which card data is cached securely on the device and uploaded later for authorization, which matches both halves of the story. The evidence is limited to a single docs page and places the feature under the Reader SDKs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, operational details (offline limits, upload/expiry timing, decline handling), and clarity on which readers or integration paths (Cloud API, Payment Switch) support it.
